question: What does the PK Zb21 first-sign disagreement establish at the actually consulted access level?
review_questions: Does the report preserve Driessen’s qualifications instead of converting all possibilities to a firm ligature?
Does the Davis excerpt establish only the first-sign proposal, rather than the entire alternative transcription?
What can be verified only from original page images or the object?
remaining_gates: Obtain and visually inspect the original pp.146–147 and Davis pp.55–56 through lawful access
Check the first-sign proposal against admissible object imagery and an expert collation
Do not infer or complete Davis’s entire word transcription from an introduction excerpt
